head: analyse
en: study parts and relationships
example: The team analysed changes in demand.
trap: analyse nesne ister; analysis isim.

head: assess
en: judge quality or extent

head: assume

head: evidence

head: significant

trap: to infinitive; be encouraged by destek/cesaretin kaynağı.

head: be encouraged by
en: gain confidence from a positive development
chunks: encouraged by progress; encouraged by feedback
example: The team was encouraged by the reduction in measurement errors.
trap: be encouraged with listesini genel temel kalıp olarak kullanma.

head: a ban on
en: an official prohibition of an activity
chunks: a ban on smoking; a ban on imports
example: The council introduced a ban on dumping waste near the river.
trap: Fiil ban smoking / ban someone from smoking; ban on isim kalıbı.

head: ban someone from doing
en: prohibit a person from an activity
chunks: ban visitors from entering; ban drivers from parking
example: The rules ban visitors from entering the storage area.
trap: from + V-ing; a ban on + isim/V-ing.

head: submit something to
tr: bir şeyi bir yere sunmak/teslim etmek
en: send material to a person or organisation
chunks: submit a report to; submit an application to
example: Applicants must submit the form to the admissions office.
trap: submit to authority otoriteye boyun eğmek ayrı nesnesiz kullanım.

head: be liable for
en: have legal responsibility for something
chunks: liable for damages; liable for payment
example: The contractor is liable for damage caused during the repairs.
trap: liable to + fiil olasılık/yatkınlık; for sorumluluk.

head: be liable to do
en: be likely to do or experience something undesirable
chunks: liable to fail; liable to change
example: Unprotected pipes are liable to freeze in severe weather.
trap: liable for costs mali sorumluluk; liable to fail eğilim/olasılık.

head: be anxious about
en: feel worried about a possible outcome
chunks: anxious about results; anxious about a delay
example: Residents were anxious about the condition of the bridge.
trap: anxious to do yapmak için hevesli de olabilir; about kaygı.

head: be familiar with
en: know something through experience
chunks: familiar with software; familiar with the route
example: The new guide was familiar with the coastal route.
trap: X is familiar to me = X bana tanıdık; I am familiar with X = X'i biliyorum.

head: be similar to
en: share relevant qualities with something
chunks: similar to a sample; similar to earlier results
example: The pattern is similar to the one observed last year.
trap: similar to; same as; edat aynı değil.

head: be different from
en: not share the same relevant qualities
chunks: different from a model; different from expectations
example: The actual route was different from the one shown on the map.
trap: different to/than bazı çeşitlerde kullanılır; burada from çekirdeğini öğren.

head: be deprived of
en: lose access to something needed
chunks: deprived of sleep; deprived of resources
example: The damaged seedlings were deprived of adequate light.
trap: deprive A of B; provide A with B zıt yönde.

head: be attributed to
en: be explained as caused by a factor
chunks: attributed to drought; attributed to an error
example: The decline was attributed to a shortage of skilled workers.
trap: Atfetmek tek başına nedenselliği ispatlamaz; contributed to farklı özne yönü.

head: be credited with
en: be recognised as responsible for an achievement
chunks: credited with discovering; credited with a reform
example: The engineer is credited with developing the safer valve.
trap: with + V-ing; attribute a success to someone eşdeğer yön dönüşümü.

head: be restricted to
en: be limited to a particular group or area
chunks: restricted to staff; restricted to weekdays
example: Access to the archive is restricted to registered researchers.
trap: restricted to erişim sınırı; restrictive sınırlayıcı sıfat.

head: be exposed to
en: come into contact with a condition or influence
chunks: exposed to radiation; exposed to noise
example: Workers were exposed to high noise levels near the machinery.
trap: exposure to; expose A to B.

head: prevent someone from doing
en: stop an action from happening
chunks: prevent drivers from entering; prevent water from escaping
example: The seal prevents water from escaping through the joint.
trap: from + V-ing; prevent to do değil.

head: distinguish between
en: recognise a difference between alternatives
chunks: distinguish between causes; distinguish A from B
example: The test distinguishes between temporary faults and permanent damage.
trap: between A and B veya distinguish A from B.

head: provide someone with
en: give a person a needed resource
chunks: provide students with books; provide a team with data
example: The archive provided researchers with digital copies.
trap: provide X for Y de mümkün; with yapısında kişi önce.

head: compensate for
en: offset a loss or disadvantage
chunks: compensate for a shortage; compensate for a delay
example: Longer opening hours compensated for the closure on Mondays.
trap: compensate someone for a loss; kişi ve kayıp yerini karıştırma.

head: regardless of
en: without being affected by a factor
chunks: regardless of age; regardless of cost
example: All applicants receive feedback regardless of the outcome.
trap: of + isim; although + cümle.

head: in spite of
en: despite a conflicting circumstance
chunks: in spite of delays; in spite of being tired
example: The team completed the survey in spite of repeated delays.
trap: despite of yanlış; in spite of doğru.

head: in terms of
en: with reference to a particular dimension
chunks: in terms of cost; in terms of accuracy
example: The methods differ mainly in terms of cost.
trap: according to kaynağa göre; in terms of değerlendirme boyutu.

head: in accordance with
en: following a rule or agreed procedure
chunks: in accordance with regulations; in accordance with a plan
example: The samples were stored in accordance with the laboratory guidelines.
trap: in contrast to karşıtlık; accordance uyum.

head: underpin
en: provide the basis for an argument or structure
chunks: underpin a theory; underpin a policy
example: Three assumptions underpin the model of household demand.
trap: undermine zayıflatmak; underpin desteklemek.

head: undermine
en: reduce strength or confidence
example: Missing records undermined confidence in the audit.
trap: underpin destekler; undermine zayıflatır.

head: pinpoint
en: identify a location or cause exactly
chunks: pinpoint a fault; pinpoint a location
example: The test helped pinpoint the source of the leak.
trap: locate bulmak; pinpoint hassas konum/neden belirleme.

head: tackle
tr: bir sorunu ele alıp çözmeye çalışmak
en: deal actively with a difficult problem
example: The plan tackles congestion by improving public transport.
trap: tackle çözmeye çalışmayı anlatır; başarı garantisi değil.

head: substantial
en: large enough to matter
example: The repair required a substantial investment in new equipment.
trap: substantiated kanıtla desteklenmiş; substantial miktar/önem.

head: negligible
en: too small to affect a judgement materially
example: The difference was negligible compared with the measurement error.
trap: neglected ihmal edilmiş; negligible ihmal edilebilir küçük.

head: explicit
en: stated directly and clearly
example: The form gave explicit instructions for reporting damaged items.
trap: implicit örtük; illicit yasa dışı farklı kök.

head: implicit
en: understood without being directly stated
example: The argument relies on an implicit assumption about equal access.
trap: explicit açıkça ifade edilmiş karşıtı.

head: adequate
en: enough for a specified purpose
example: The storage room lacked adequate ventilation.
trap: appropriate uygun; adequate yeterli miktar/düzey.

head: excessive
en: greater than a useful or acceptable amount
example: Excessive heat damaged the stored seeds.
trap: accessible erişilebilir; excessive miktar fazlası.

head: fragile
en: easily damaged or disrupted
chunks: a fragile object; a fragile agreement
example: The fragile agreement depended on continued cooperation.
trap: resilient toparlanabilen; fragile kolay bozulan.

head: arduous
en: requiring sustained hard effort
chunks: an arduous journey; an arduous task
example: Restoring the damaged archive was an arduous task.
trap: hazardous tehlikeli; arduous zor/emek yoğun.

head: dubious
en: uncertain or questionable
example: The product's claimed benefits were based on dubious evidence.
trap: sceptical kuşku duyan kişi; dubious kuşkulu şey veya emin olmayan kişi.

head: legitimate
en: accepted as lawful or reasonable
example: Residents raised legitimate concerns about access to the clinic.
trap: legal hukuka uygun; legitimate makul/meşru kapsamı daha geniş.

head: transmission
en: the passing of a signal or condition between points
example: The barrier reduced the transmission of sound between rooms.
trap: transition geçiş; transmission aktarım.

head: disparity
en: a substantial difference between groups
example: The report documented a disparity in access to clean water.
trap: similarity benzerlik; disparity eşit olmayan fark.

head: retention
en: keeping something over time
example: Regular retrieval practice improved retention of the new vocabulary.
trap: retrieval geri çağırma; retention bellekte kalma.

head: precedent
en: an earlier case guiding a later decision
example: The ruling set a precedent for similar disputes.
trap: president başkan; precedent karar için önceki örnek.

head: remnant
en: a small part left after most has gone
chunks: a remnant of a wall; forest remnants
example: The excavators found a remnant of the original stone floor.
trap: remainder kalan miktar; remnant çoğu kez eski yapının küçük izi.

head: concession
en: a compromise granted to another side
chunks: make a concession; a major concession
example: Both sides made a concession to reach an agreement.
trap: concession bağlaçlarda taviz ilişkisi; permission genel izin.

head: enhance
en: improve quality or increase a desirable effect
example: Clear diagrams enhanced students' understanding of the process.
trap: increase miktarı artırır; enhance çoğu kez kalite/etkiyi geliştirir.

head: eliminate
en: remove something entirely from consideration or presence
chunks: eliminate an error; eliminate an option
example: The additional evidence eliminated two possible explanations.
trap: alleviate hafifletir; eliminate çıkarır/ortadan kaldırır.

head: hint
en: a small indication or an indirect suggestion
chunks: a hint of change; hint at a solution
example: The letters provide a hint of tension between the two families.
trap: hint at ima etmek; conclusive evidence kesin sonuç veren kanıt değildir.

head: recognise
en: identify something familiar or acknowledge its significance
chunks: recognise a pattern; recognise the importance of
example: The reviewers recognised the importance of the missing control group.
trap: recognize Amerikan yazımı; realise farkına varmak yakın fakat her yerde aynı değil.

head: violently
en: with great force or harmful aggression
example: The unsecured panel shook violently in the wind.
trap: severely derece/ciddiyet; violently güç veya şiddet vurgular.
